Privacy Policy

How Hello Customer handles information.

Prelaunch website notice · 22 November 2026

Introduction

Hello Customer is a business communication and customer engagement platform operated by SaralKaro. This policy explains how information is collected, used, processed, shared, secured, retained and deleted.

Information we process

Depending on features used, information may include business and authorized-user details; subscription information; customer names, phone numbers, contact lists, consent and opt-out records; campaign content, schedules, recipient selections and delivery results; payment and subscription records; and necessary authentication, device, security, application and audit records. This prelaunch website only processes form entries locally in the browser and does not submit them.

How information is used

Business details, customer contact information and consent or opt-out preferences support the service. Campaign content, schedules and delivery results support campaign creation and monitoring. Payment and subscription information manages billing, plans, quotas and access. Planned AI features may process user-submitted content after providers and arrangements are finalized; customer contact lists should not be sent where unnecessary.

WhatsApp Business integration

Hello Customer intends to use supported WhatsApp Business Platform integrations. Relevant information may be processed by Meta under applicable terms. Businesses are responsible for permission to contact customers; unrestricted messaging is not offered.

Security measures

Implemented safeguards include server-side access controls, secure authentication, private media controls, redacted provider errors and audit records. Provider credentials are designed for encrypted storage. No system can guarantee absolute security, and provider-dependent controls remain unavailable until configured.

Third-party providers

Service providers may support WhatsApp messaging, hosting, database and private storage, payments, future AI, authentication, monitoring and technical support. Specific providers are named only when their use is confirmed and operational.

Retention

Information is retained only as necessary for operational, contractual, security and legal purposes. Exact production periods and deletion behavior must be verified before public account registration; no arbitrary period is promised.

Rights and requests

Applicable requests may concern access, correction, updating, deletion, consent withdrawal, opt-outs or privacy complaints. Requests are verified and handled according to applicable Indian law and party roles.
